l.i: Longas malum ante quā inualescat per moras.
Tu, Crispe, qui Græcam fidē atq; linguā amas,
Non es Magister Noster equidem: sed tamen
Quoniam Gnatho Sueui illius Thrasonis es,
Eiq; linguam vendis, haud quaquam memor
Quod olim Erasti assensus es sententiæ,
Te moneo, vtite corrigas, loco vltimo.
Ægrè nec id feras, quod aio; loco vltimo,
Maximus enim in Processione es vltimus.
Holdere, dixi hæc, vt vides, sine hyperbole,
Emblematum est vti quibus visum loco.

page.notes: Doubtful: "vtite" in line 7 may be printed as "vt ite" (narrow space). "Holdere" in line 10 is as printed, probably a proper name. The faint show-through text lower on the page (mirrored from the other side) is left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
